confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'this points to a fault with the automatic defrost system rather than just user error. The most common cause is that the heater or thermostat has failed' - stated before knowing the appliance type, which turned out to be a static manual-defrost freezer

rationale: The opening turn jumped to an automatic-defrost heater/thermostat fault and dismissed simpler causes before knowing the appliance was a static manual-defrost unit, and pushed a 'suitable replacement' panel before any part was identified. After the customer corrected it, the assistant recovered well: safe unplug-and-defrost advice, a sensible seal inspection plus paper test, and a correct door-gasket diagnosis once the 5cm split was reported. The part recommendation was justified by confirmed seal damage and the known model, with honest admission that no confirmed match was in its database, though it assumed a push-in fitting and skipped the door-alignment check and any mention of the kids yanking the drawer.
